column1: # Tools' own scripts that a shell profile sources from where Homebrew installs them, outside the home
# folder. An account run in fleet mode reads the files a profile sources (data/folder-vars.tsv says
# why) but not these: each is the tool's own code, which sets its tool's variable its own way. Matched
# only as the profile writes the whole path, from Homebrew's prefix: /opt/homebrew/opt/TOOL/SCRIPT,
# $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/TOOL/SCRIPT or ${HOMEBREW_PREFIX}/opt/TOOL/SCRIPT. Never by how a path ends: a
# file with the same name anywhere else is read like any other. One line each, tab separated. After
#   script   the script, below the formula's folder: plain characters, parts separated by /
#   what     the install that puts it there

column3: nvm installed with Homebrew: its caveat sources $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/nvm/nvm.sh
nvm installed with Homebrew: its completion, from the same caveat
